description:
pkix-ct/src/verify.rs:384-425 — verify_embedded_scts() encodes leaf_cert and issuer_cert once before the loop (lines 406-413). Good. But then each iteration calls verify_sct_for_precert(sct, &leaf_der, &issuer_der), which in turn calls tbs_without_sct_list(&leaf_der) (parses+strips+re-encodes) and issuer_key_hash_from_cert(&issuer_der) (parses+re-encodes+hashes).

For N SCTs in one cert (typical: 2-5; CT BR allows up to ~5), the inner per-SCT work is:
- Parse leaf DER → Certificate (~tens of microseconds for a small cert)
- Re-encode TBS minus SCT-list ext (similar)
- Parse issuer DER → Certificate
- Encode issuer SPKI
- SHA-256 the SPKI

All five of these are deterministic across iterations — they depend only on the (leaf, issuer) pair, not on the per-SCT data. They should be computed once outside the loop.

Concrete improvement: hoist tbs_no_sct and issuer_key_hash out of verify_sct_for_precert (or add a verify_sct_for_precert_with_precomputed() variant). For N=5 SCTs, current implementation does the work 5x — measurable on first-page-load TLS handshakes.

Suggested fix (non-breaking even post-1.0): keep the simple verify_sct_for_precert as-is, and add a faster batch entry point that pre-computes the (tbs_no_sct, issuer_key_hash) pair once. verify_embedded_scts then uses the batch entry point internally.
title: verify_embedded_scts re-encodes leaf+issuer DER once but verify_sct_for_precert re-parses cert N times in the inner loop
